note: Trigger-routing suite, carried over from the skill's adiav2 origin (2026-07-25) at elevation into harness (2026-07-30). Positives are verbatim or near-verbatim asks from the authoring session (t01/t02 are the literal user asks that motivated the skill; t16 is the explicit slash-command path). Negatives are near misses this skill must not steal: in a host repo they are typically owned by project siblings (PR creation, ticket pickup, CI diagnosis, code review, single-artifact summaries); in a bare install they are simply unowned — either way, no-trigger. t15 names Linear as a phrasing users actually type; the skill itself is ticket-backend-agnostic (doc-writing-rules' backend resolver).
